critical_code_review_comments: Backend store attributes endpoint (PUT /api/buy-planning/stores/{store_code}/attributes):
- Validates store_format: hypermarket, supermarket, convenience
- Validates city_tier: tier1, tier2, tier3
- Validates region: North, South, East, West, Central
- Updates area_sqft as integer
- Returns 404 for nonexistent store, 400 for invalid values or empty body
- Logs changes to buy_planning_audit_log
Backend exclusion endpoints:
- POST /api/buy-planning/exclusions: Creates/upserts store-SKU exclusion
- GET /api/buy-planning/exclusions: Lists all exclusions for tenant
- DELETE /api/buy-planning/exclusions/{store_code}/{sku}: Removes exclusion, returns 404 if not found
Buy formula exclusion integration:
- Loads exclusions from buy_planning_exclusions collection
- Skips excluded SKUs during calculation
- Returns excluded_skus count in totals object
Frontend Store Wedge tab:
- 4 filter dropdowns: store-wedge-filter, store-region-filter, store-tier-filter, store-format-filter
- Table shows Region, Format (colored badge), Tier (colored badge), Area columns
- Settings icon opens store edit modal with dropdowns for format, tier, region and input for area
- Save Attributes button (save-store-attrs-btn) calls PUT endpoint
Frontend Buy Plan tab:
- Manage Exclusions button (manage-exclusions-btn) opens exclusion modal
- Exclusion modal (exclusion-modal) has add form with excl-store-input, excl-sku-input
- Exclusion list shows Store, SKU, Reason columns with X button to remove
seed_data_creation: Test exclusions created and cleaned up during testing. DEL-01 store attributes updated to hypermarket/tier1/North/15000.
